name: Flood Plain Management Study — Clam River, Wexford County, Michigan.pdf
description: Historic Soil Conservation Service study of the Clam River, Lake Cadillac, Lake Mitchell and Pleasant Lake. It includes flood-hazard photomaps, profiles and 10-, 50-, 100- and 500-year discharge/elevation tables. It is receptor and watershed context, not proof of PFAS contamination or source attribution.

name: EPA Region 5 Michigan First-Quarter 2010 QNCR.pdf
description: EPA Region 5 Quarterly Non-Compliance Report dated March 15, 2010 for the October–December 2009 quarter. Its Cadillac WWTP entry lists total mercury at outfall 001A, violation date July 31, 2005, with status 'NC — continuing noncompliance.'

name: EPA ICIS Michigan Second-Quarter 2014 QNCR.pdf
description: EPA ICIS Quarterly Non-Compliance Report for January–March 2014. The Cadillac WWTP detail row records an overdue DMR for outfall 001, violation date December 31, 2013, status date February 20, 2014, and code 2D reporting violation; no linked enforcement action or final order is shown.

name: N3862 Scheduled Inspection — Wexford County Landfill.pdf
description: November 6, 2017 AQD scheduled inspection for state registration N3862. The report records compliance, a 3.45-million-Mg design capacity, active landfill-gas collection and flare, post-closure groundwater-remediation aeration ponds and an exempt leachate evaporation system. The separate '(1)' filename was an exact duplicate and is not carried forward.

name: Wexford County Landfill Tier 2 NMOC Results.pdf
description: March 10, 2021 report on January 19–21 Tier 2 sampling. LandGEM estimates 35.81 Mg/year average and 38.64 Mg/year maximum NMOC for 2021, below the 50-Mg/year threshold, while projecting later threshold crossings under its stated waste assumptions. Retesting was due by January 19, 2026.

name: N3862 Renewable Operating Permit Staff Report.pdf
description: August 15, 2022 staff report and September 15 addendum for MI-ROP-N3862-2022. It records leachate injection beginning in early 2019, closure/removal of the aeration ponds since 2017, 2021 emissions, March 2022 Tier 2 NMOC calculations and AQD's expected-compliance finding.

name: Cadillac WWTP CWSRF Project Plan and Funding Proposal.pdf
description: February 2, 2026 Council communication and F&V proposal for a $36,800 CWSRF project plan. Candidate improvements include headworks, blowers, UV disinfection, solids handling, biogas use and site repairs; the selected construction project was not yet fixed by this planning proposal.
